title: Drifter Desserts Banana Caramel Waffle 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Banana Caramel Waffle by Drifter Desserts serves up the rich sweetness of ripe Banana, drizzled with golden Caramel and layered over a warm, fluffy Waffle base. The result is a dessert-inspired vape that blends fruit, sweetness, and pastry notes into a comforting profile. Created with a 50VG/50PG balance, this Nic Salt e-liquid provides smooth flavour delivery, discreet vapour output, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, it’s best enjoyed with pod vapes, refillable vape pens, and compact starter kits. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it allows for a tailored vaping experience. Part of the Drifter Desserts line by Juice Sauz, this UK-made range reflects the brand’s expertise in crafting authentic, flavour-rich e-liquids. Take your refillable vape or vape starter kit to the next level with this reliable liquid.
